alert_news.title: Kerala’s Plan for India’s First Electric Truck Corridor
bullets: India’s first electric truck corridor along National Highway 66, spanning 622 km from Kasaragod to Thiruvananthapuram, proposed by Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB).
Charging network to comprise 1,939 chargers with a total capacity of 12.5 MW.
Funding of ₹2,000 crore from the Union Ministry of Heavy Industries under the PM E‑DRIVE scheme, supplemented by ₹63.12 crore already earmarked for state charging infrastructure.

alert_news.title: ISRO's GSLV‑F17 Mission to Launch India's First Geosynchronous Imaging Satellite EOS‑05
bullets: EOS‑05 will be India's first Earth‑observation imaging satellite intended for a geosynchronous orbit, launched aboard GSLV‑F17.
The 2,367 kg satellite will be injected into a Sub‑GTO with perigee 170 km, apogee 28,934 km, and inclination ~19.28°.

alert_news.title: KSEB plans to open 200 fast EV charging stations within a year - The New Indian Express
bullets: India’s first state‑led electric truck corridor on NH 66, Kerala, built by Kerala State Electricity Board Ltd (KSEBL)
622‑km stretch to be equipped with 200 fast‑charging stations, 12.5 MW charging capacity, and Rs 19 crore investment

alert_news.title: ISRO EOS-05 Satellite Launch | Geosynchronous Orbit Updates | India News
bullets: EOS‑05 will be India’s first imaging satellite to operate from a geosynchronous orbit, launched by ISRO on GSLV‑F17
Satellite will orbit at ~36,000 km, enabling continuous monitoring of large land areas for disaster management

alert_news.title: Gujarat Launches India's First State-Level Sports Genomics Programme
bullets: Gujarat is the first Indian state to launch a Sports Genomics Programme, driven by the Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre under the Department of Science & Technology.
The programme aims to collect 2,000 athlete samples annually and 10,000 samples over five years, focusing on whole‑genome sequencing to identify genetic markers linked to athletic performance.
It will create the Gujarat Athlete Genome Database (G‑AGD) integrating genetic, physiological and performance data for long‑term research and athlete profiling.

alert_news.title: Odisha Lok Bhavan Becomes India's First IGBC Platinum‑Certified Green Campus
bullets: Odisha Lok Bhavan is the first Governor House in India to receive IGBC Platinum certification under the Green Campus Rating System.
The campus scored 88 out of 100 points, the highest category in the IGBC rating, and is the first Lok Bhavan to adopt an all‑electric official carcade.
It marks the first ever Platinum‑rated campus under the revised IGBC Green Campus v1 rating system launched in July 2024.

alert_news.title: ISRO To Launch EOS-05 On GSLV-F17 On September 4; India Set For New 'Eye In The Sky'
bullets: EOS-05 is India's first geosynchronous imaging satellite, launched from Sriharikota on 4 September 2026 aboard GSLV‑F17
Weighing 2,367 kg, it provides persistent, frequent imaging of the Indian subcontinent for weather, disaster, agriculture and environmental monitoring

alert_news.title: Who Is Shakti Sharma? Meet India's First Woman Non-Medical Air Vice Marshal
bullets: Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma became India's first woman officer from the non‑medical branch of the Defence Services to attain the rank of Air Vice Marshal on 1 September 2026
She was appointed Assistant Chief of the Air Staff (Education) at Air Headquarters, marking a historic first for women in the Indian Air Force

alert_news.title: GSLV‑F17/EOS‑05 Mission – First Indian Geosynchronous Earth‑Observation Imaging Satellite
bullets: First Indian Earth‑observation imaging satellite (EOS‑05) intended for a geosynchronous orbit, marking a historic ISRO capability
Carried on GSLV‑F17, a three‑stage heavy‑lift launch vehicle (51.7 m tall, 420.5 t lift‑off mass) with launch slated for 4 Sept 2026

alert_news.title: Kerala to launch India's First State‑Led Electric Truck Corridor on NH‑66
bullets: India's first electric truck corridor planned on the 622 km stretch of NH 66 in Kerala, led by Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB)
Requires 12.5 MW charging capacity and Rs 19 crore investment; includes 207 fast‑charging stations (≈200 to be operational within a year) with 20‑minute full charge

alert_news.title: Odisha's Lok Bhavan becomes India's first Platinum certified green Lok Bhavan
bullets: First Lok Bhavan in India to receive IGBC Platinum green certification, located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha
First campus in India to achieve Platinum under the stricter Green Campus v1 rating system (score 88/100), with 635 kWp solar PV and 35% reduction in water consumption

alert_news.title: India's First Imaging Satellite in Sub-Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (EOS-05)
bullets: EOS-05, India's first imaging satellite to operate from Sub-Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (Sub‑GTO), launched by GSLV‑F17 from Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota on 4 September 2026.
Satellite mass 2,367 kg, equipped with multi‑spectral and hyper‑spectral imaging, provides 42 m spatial resolution and can image the entire Indian landmass every 30 minutes.

alert_news.title: India's First Combined Pulsed Field Ablation and Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion Procedure
bullets: First combined Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA) for atrial fibrillation and Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion (LAAO) performed in India at Lilavati Hospital, Mumbai on 14 August 2026.
Procedure treated a 77‑year‑old patient, eliminating AF and stroke risk in a single minimally invasive intervention.

alert_news.title: India launches first AI‑powered safety platform, AgniKawach
bullets: India’s first indigenous AI‑integrated process‑safety and consequence‑modelling platform, AgniKawach, developed by Agnikawach Safety Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

The platform combines AI, GPU‑native computing, adaptive‑mesh CFD and cloud delivery to model eight major industrial hazards, offering a unified, affordable solution for sectors such as green hydrogen, LNG, petrochemicals and defense.

alert_news.title: IIT Gandhinagar launches India's first postgraduate AI program on campus
bullets: First postgraduate AI program delivered entirely on an IIT campus, launched at IIT Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
Residential PG Diploma in AI‑ML & Agentic AI Engineering, starting September 2026, focused on Forward Deployed Engineering roles.

alert_news.title: Mumbai to host India's first large‑scale SpaceFest event
bullets: First large‑scale event dedicated to space, science, innovation and space‑inspired pop culture in India, to be held in Mumbai.
SpaceFest 2026 will feature dedicated zones for sci‑fi and gaming, aiming to blend knowledge and entertainment.

alert_news.title: IIT Gandhinagar's PG Diploma in AI-ML & Agentic AI Engineering to Begin New Cohort in September 2026
bullets: India’s first postgraduate AI program delivered entirely on an IIT campus, offered by IIT Gandhinagar as a residential PG Diploma in AI‑ML & Agentic AI Engineering.
The program, starting September 2026, is fully residential on the 400‑acre campus and differs from other IIT AI programmes that are online or weekend‑format.

alert_news.title: Mumbai to host the first edition of SpaceFest, celebrating space and science
bullets: India’s first large‑scale event dedicated to space, science, innovation and space‑inspired pop culture – SpaceFest – to be held in Mumbai.
The inaugural edition is scheduled for 2026 and aims to combine knowledge dissemination with entertainment, featuring dedicated zones for sci‑fi and gaming.
